# NOTES: "The Ghost of Mystery Airport" by Van Powell (Saalfield, 1932; Gutenberg #46656). Single book, no BOOK headings. Chapters I–XXXII.

## Metadata/Setup
- Title page: THE GHOST OF MYSTERY AIRPORT, by Van Powell. Saalfield Publishing Co., Akron, Ohio & New York. Copyright MCMXXXII.
- Setting: Port Washington, Long Island, NY; July. Airport near Little Neck Bay / Long Island Sound; swamp (Devil's Sink / Devil's Sinkhole, Crab Channel) adjacent; salt marsh to be drained. Airport owner: Bruce McLeod ("Uncle Bruce"), airport designer/airways specialist. Nephew: Don McLeod, 17, amateur pilot. Airport control chief: J. V. (John Vance). Doc Morgan: general helper, herb "doctor," drinks, nicknamed "Doc."

## Main Characters
- **Garry (Garfield) Duncan**, 15, student-pilot, cool, practical, studied airplane design/blueprints; nicknamed chums.
- **Chick (Chickering Brown)**, 13, impulsive, brave-boasting, later kind; collector of stamps (Bavarian/Venezuelan duplicates, cancelled American 2-cent stamps); in manila envelope in coat pocket.
- **Don McLeod**, 17, nephew, pilot of Dragonfly (three-place amphibian, white wings) and Dart (light fast two-seater, red-lacquered, personal property of Bruce McLeod).
- **Scott ("Great Scott")**, test pilot for Italian-style seaplane/aircraft plant; "likes spooks"; hangar supervisor; secretly the villain. Injured by a prop hub breakage on Dart (feigned). Limps with bandaged left thigh later.
- **Toby Tew**: runs the Palace motion picture theatre (Winter); rents dories in Summer; boathouse owner; "Gosh-a-mighty!" / "In the name of all-possessed!" Red herring; innocent.
- **Ti-O-Ga**: old Indian "medicine man," Hudson/Catskill region; cottage with telephone; gave Garry a pouch "charm to clip ghost wings" (contained three free passes to the Palace Theatre). Wax seal with swastika-cross. Son **John Tioga** (John Ti), ~19, educated (Carlisle), Navy cadet training school, moving-picture actor/magician-devil, sullen, fast, can fly; wears copper-colored skin, black hair.
- Mail flyer **Smith** (tall, thin; flies mail from Philadelphia), mentioned by Ti; fake mail pilot.
- Police Chief (unnamed, good-natured, big voice). Inspector from postal dept (arrives in land plane, summons boys to NY Chief at 9 a.m.).
- Henry: airport mechanician. Chubby: control assistant.
- Caledonia: trans-Atlantic liner delivering mail pouches from Liverpool.

## Sequence of Events
1. **Ch I–II**: Night, July, Scott takes Garry and Chick (in three-place biplane Dragonfly) over Long Island swamp to hunt "Sky Spook." Scott says first pilot crashed claiming ghost ship from luminous cloud; ghost reappears every seventh day (this is 7th night after last time; four successive weeks). Plan: Don flies Dart as bait; Scott in Dragonfly; flares: red flare = spook in clouds, green Verey = spook takes off from ground. Ghost "Thing" appears; it's Don in Dart (not ghost). Scott tells legend: old clam-digger "Ike" saw two old biplanes collide over Devil's Sink (skeleton found there). Scott names group "Airlane Guard." Scott flies Dragonfly; Don in Dart.
2. **Ch III**: Don in Dart (Chick screams "There it is!"). First crack-up pilot (mail-plane pilot? earlier) claimed ghost. Mail 'plane approaching (from liner, mail from ship 100 mi out). Ghost planes seen in cloud; Dart flies into cloud; no crash heard; Dragonfly (Garry/Chick) sees two shadows collide.
3. **Ch IV**: Storm; Dart/Dragonfly lands by old dock/boathouse with two-room shack; Chick finds Doc Morgan drunk in boathouse, with tracing (plans of new all-metal ship) blowing out; Doc says he saw "It," green-haired figure. Chick accuses Doc of traitor. Scott arrives.
4. **Ch V**: Don & Garry row dory to mail 'plane wreck; Garry climbs wing, gets mail sack; pilot missing; they return; Chick seen struggling with figure at boathouse. Pilot (mail, "Help!") found, hurt; Don and Garry carry him to Dragonfly; they take off with mail.
5. **Ch VI**: Chick accuses Doc; Chick pins tracing in coat pocket; Doc leaves. Scott says "Light two red flare signals." Chick back in shack; "Thing That Never Was—Man Who Never Lived" voice; green-slimed figure chases; grabs Chick's coat pocket, tears it; takes stamp envelope; runs.
6. **Ch VII**: Don flies Dragonfly above storms; Garry fixes broken elevator cables by reaching in through floor; landing in field amid hills (near Catskill).
7. **Ch VIII**: Chick alone in swamp; back to boathouse; tracing still safe (Doc grabbed stamps). Trap door in boathouse floor. Knock; door opens; Toby Tew appears (rescues). Chick realizes tracing is from control room drawer.
8. **Ch IX**: Toby Tew: tracing identified as sketch of "hull of an old-time sailing brig." India waterproof ink observed on wings/struts. Toby: "It's the hull of an old-time sailing brig!" Third mystery.
9. **Ch X**: Farmer; Ti-O-Ga (Indian) telephone; examines mail pilot; Garry taken to Ti-O-Ga's cottage; Ti-O-Ga puts him to sleep; gives charm pouch: "Put in box for seven day! Not touch! Then—open!" "Charm to clip ghost wings."
10. **Ch XI**: Control room; control chief J. V. Vance claims tracing (initials J.V. at bow angle); Vance says he drew initials on tracing. Scott's plan: he to fly Caledonia mail; Scott hurt (propeller). Don flies Dragonfly with Garry & Chick; takes mail from Caledonia.
11. **Ch XII**: Dragonfly mail flight; helicopter seen over swamp; liner Caledonia; Don snatches buoyed mail pouches (Chick grabs, Garry directs). Back to airport.
12. **Ch XIII**: Rockets (flying bombs) from helicopter; Don does Immelmann turn, barrel rolls; helicopter with figure in green oilskins/green head covering.
13. **Ch XIV**: Chick suggests barrel rolls, falling leaf; Don lands at airport; Vance & Doc; Dart prop repaired; Don takes Dart with Garry to swamp to find helicopter. Chick stays at tower.
14. **Ch XV**: Garry sees flicker (lure) under helicopter; Garry goes by crash launch (electric boat) up Crab Channel. Helicopter with pontoons; green-oilskinned figure with flashlight.
15. **Ch XVI**: Chick follows Vance & Doc in tower; Doc says tracing & skeleton & pirate "Morgan" connection; Vance drew initials; drawer found unlocked, tracing gone. Chick finds design room tampered; Indian youth (John) hiding behind Japanese screen; flees; Chick chases; John drives sedan away.
17. **Ch XVII**: Aerial capture: Don (Dart) and Garry (crash launch) trap the helicopter; John Ti surrenders (white flare), Chick & Vance arrive. John is the "Demon."
18. **Ch XVIII**: Confession: John; father Ti-O-Ga; Doc Morgan came to Ti to find lost ship; Smith (mail pilot) visited; John says tall "Thing" in helicopter. Garry realizes charm passes: seven days; "Three free passes for the Palace Theatre."
19. **Ch XIX**: Palace theatre; smoke-screen projection shows spectre pictures on smoke. Passes given; Don deduces projection from above/by helicopter; Chick deduces film projector & calcium light (lamp at boathouse).
20. **Ch XX**: Toby as suspect; Garry says spectre projection from control room; Chick finds key in Vance's vest fits pilots' locker; projector "head" found; film of aviation scene.
21. **Ch XXI**: Don's test flight in Dart: projects spectre image on cloud; Verey green flare; Don sees ghost ship; Garry says film started with airplanes over swamp; Chick & Don deduce; Dr. Morgan (Doc) suspicion; "someone behind screen" listens.
22. **Ch XXII**: Don & Chick (Dart) use helicopter for projection at boathouse dories; Chick operates projector; Mail 'plane approaches; spectre projected; mail pilot dives.
23. **Ch XXIII**: Garry takes Dragonfly; sees mail pilot (Scott/Smith?) angry; mail pilot dives at helicopter; Garry intervenes.
24. **Ch XXIV**: Chick fires green Verey; Garry drives across; mail pilot's prop wash almost kills; Government plane (postal inspector) arrives with red Verey lights; Don lands helicopter. Crowd. Postal Inspector summons boys to NY Chief at 9 a.m.
25. **Ch XXV**: Toby saves them by "publicity stunt"; Scott limps in (bandaged left thigh); Scott says don't go; "Eight hours' leeway"; Indians chased, escape into swamp. Chick develops undeveloped film from projector case (film light-fogged).
26. **Ch XXVI**: Dark-room; smoke bomb attack; door slammed; film lost; fire; Garry douses; chase; Scott seen fleeing; Dragonfly launched; John in Dart.
27. **Ch XXVII**: Chase: Dragonfly (white wings) vs. Dart (red wings) by John; John turns on Don, thinking Don is culprit; Don surrenders; John surrenders.
28. **Ch XXVIII**: John's story: old sailor gave map (brig, Devil's Sinkhole, treasure jewels/gold/silver). Mail flyer visited Ti's cottage and photographed map with vest-pocket camera. Doc Morgan phoned John at theatre saying the mail pilot was flying the mail. Doc denies.
29. **Ch XXIX**: Dark-room; Chick's intensified blueprint reveals map (camouflaged brig hull, cross-marked treasure); Chief of police arrives; "ghost" trick.
30. **Ch XXX**: Plan: Don pretends to find treasure; Police Chief; Don & Ti; Garry & Chick at boathouse, waiting.
31. **Ch XXXI**: Mail flyer ("Demon") emerges from trap door in Garry's presence; trap; reveals himself as Scott (disguise), not Toby; tear-gas bomb; escapes in crash launch.
32. **Ch XXXII**: Scott's plane: hidden hangar of boards; Garry attacks; Scott flees with treasure in Dart; Don chases in Dragonfly; crosses Long Island Sound; Scott's plane hit by tear-gas bomb from Don's barrel roll; Scott crashes on shore. "And thus the Ghost of Mystery Airport passed."

## Key Facts/Quotes
- "Great Scott" = Scott nickname. "Airlane Guard." "Charm to clip ghost wings." "Man Who Never Lived."
- Ghost appeared "every seven days"; seventh night after last time.
- Devil's Sink; brig; skeleton; Ike (old clam-digger); Society for Psychical Research "Proceedings."
- Treasure: "jewels and gold and silver"; brig "Lady O' Fortune" (named by Scott-in-disguise).
- Doc's pirate surname Morgan (Doc Morgan). Vance's initials J.V.
- Chick's stamp envelope stolen by Scott/"Thing."
